integrity: The universal low-degree and two-dimensional statements are proved by explicit Chebyshev polynomial reduction and Stieltjes sign structure. The three-dimensional obstruction is an exact rational witness. The checker verifies only the finite algebra and is not used to infer the universal statements.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes exact arithmetic, zero initial guess, symmetric positive definite Stieltjes matrices, and Chebyshev parameters from the exact extremal eigenvalues. The counterexample is reducible. It does not classify later degrees, loose spectral enclosures, nonsymmetric M-matrices, or finite-precision implementations.
title: Degree three and dimension three are jointly minimal for Chebyshev positivity loss
